name: Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Mocha'
story_html: This Air Jordan 3 Retro ‘Mocha’ dropped in September 2001. It comes with a tumbled white leather upper with smooth white leather at the base and perforated detailing at the tongue, eyestays, and heel. It also features a Dark Mocha elephant skin overlays at the toe and heel, as well as Dark Mocha accents on the top eyelets and tongue and heel branding. The upper comes mounted on a white midsole with a Dark Mocha Air unit in the heel and a matching outsole.
